paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Expert win rates 0.90\% in EBS feedback judgment. Our annotations achieve an average win rate of 88.890.90\%. All 12 LLMs exceed an 820.90\% rate in preferring our EBS.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the expert win rate for twelve large language models, along with an average rate. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are labels for each model—Average, GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and GLM-4-Plus—presented in a specific order without apparent sorting. The vertical axis, labeled “Expert Win Rate (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels appearing at 20-unit intervals. Each model is represented by a solid-colored bar; the bars range in height from approximately 82.26% for DeepSeek-V3 to 97.56% for Claude 3 Opus. The ‘Average’ bar is a dark grey color and extends to 88.89%, while the remaining bars are each a different shade of grey, lavender, or beige. Each bar is annotated with its precise win rate value. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations beyond the numerical value.
